entries.title: World of Warplanes
entries.definitive_edition: Current Windows PC live client with region/account/build state documented

primary.version: Current Wargaming PC build / 2.0-era live service
primary.why: World of Warplanes is a Wargaming live-service aerial-combat MMO whose roster, balance, regions, economy, and bot/player population change over time. The PC live client is the only meaningful archive route, with exact build and account state documented.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC client through Wargaming Game Center or Steam. Record region/server, build/date, account, aircraft/tiers, premium/economy state, events, mode, control scheme, graphics settings, and bot/player population context.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Live-service patch, region, account, aircraft roster, economy, events, and population define the archive state.
